adds.title: Captain Marvel
adds.text: After the Snap, Bruce and Steve work together at the Avengers compound to find out who Fury's pager was signaling.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger studying Fury's pager with Bruce after the Snap.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger studying Fury's pager with Steve after the Snap.
adds.evidence: Mid-credits scene set in 2018: Steve, Natasha and Rhodes talk with Bruce about Fury's pager at the Avengers compound until it shuts off and Carol appears.

adds.title: Captain Marvel
adds.text: Natasha is with the Avengers watching Fury's pager when Carol answers its call and appears, demanding to know where Fury is.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger watching Fury's pager when Carol arrives asking for him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Fury's pager reaches, who appears asking where he is.
adds.evidence: Mid-credits scene: the remaining Avengers, Natasha among them, discuss who Fury was trying to contact when Danvers appears and asks where he is.

adds.title: Captain Marvel
adds.text: Fury helps rescue Talos' young daughter G'iah and the other Skrull refugees hidden on Mar-Vell's lab, then shares a meal with them at the Rambeau home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who helps rescue G'iah and the refugees from the Kree.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Talos' young daughter, whom Fury helps rescue from the Kree.
adds.evidence: Danvers, Fury, Talos and Maria reach Mar-Vell's lab, where Talos is reunited with his wife and daughter; the Skrulls escape on the jet with Rambeau and Fury, and the refugees then share a meal with their rescuers at the Rambeau house (soundtrack listing: Carol, Fury, Maria, Talos and Soren eat dinner as Monica, G'iah and Goose sit on the stairs).
